cases.selection_boundary: Request files contain task, observed changed aliases, selected full-v2 evidence and locally validated allowed IDs only; no oracle outputs or plans.

protocol.absolute_reliability: Schema-valid graph plans; non-abstaining complete recovery when recoverable affected reports exist; valid empty non-abstaining no-op; missing-only explicit abstention or expected execution refusal; independent numeric/provenance-current, zero incorrect-current and immutable originals preserved
protocol.arm_order: rotate fixed six-arm list left by case index modulo six
protocol.complete_study: all 48 planned cells attempted once, usage/billing known and scored; missing cells are not zero-filled
protocol.input_exposure: modelUsage inputTokens + cacheCreationInputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens; top-level usage is not added
protocol.invocation_scope: one harness invocation may contain multiple CLI/provider turns; num_turns and aggregate usage retained
protocol.primary_ratio_cases: all non-no-op planned cases; including-no-op ratio is secondary

retrieval.dense_document_score: maximum cosine across all overlapping chunks
retrieval.evidence_budget: complete native graph closure token count shared by five capped arms; full context uncapped

protocol.shared_executor: Every arm uses the same frozen Hydra-assisted currentness and recursive refresh executor; standalone vector safety not evaluated
